title: Launching Win Back Campaigns: How to Reactivate Lost Customers.

facts.fact: Marketing Metrics puts the probability of selling to a lost customer again at 20%–40%.
facts.quote: Marketing Metrics puts the probability of selling to a lost customer again at 20%–40%

facts.fact: The article states that a cold prospect offers a 5-20% probability of sale, though it gives no source for this figure.
facts.quote: streets ahead of the 5-20% you can expect from a cold prospect

facts.fact: The article states that around 47% of reactivated customers go on to spend more than they did before they left; the figure is given without a named source.
facts.quote: Around 47% of reactivated customers go on to spend more than they did before they left.

facts.fact: Before the COVID-19 lockdowns, JD Gyms traded from 30 sites.
facts.quote: JD Gyms were trading from 30 sites and building real momentum

facts.fact: The article was published on 13 June 2025.
According to the page's channel table, loyalty programme messaging is triggered 7–30 days after last activity, with weekly value-add communication.
facts.quote: Loyalty Programmes 7–30 days after last activity Ongoing engagement opportunities Weekly value-add communication

facts.fact: According to the page's channel table, email win-back campaigns start 30–90 days after last activity (around day 45), with 3–5 messages sent every 3–5 days.
facts.quote: Email 30–90 days (start around day 45)3–5 messages Every 3–5 days

facts.fact: According to the page's channel table, SMS win-back is triggered 60–75 days after last activity, with up to 3 messages at 7–14 day intervals.
facts.quote: SMS 60–75 days Up to 3 messages 7–14 days (weekly or bi-weekly)

facts.fact: According to the page's channel table, push notifications are sent at 7, 14, and 30 days of inactivity, with 2–3 nudges.
facts.quote: Push Notifications 7, 14, 30 days of inactivity 2–3 nudges Tied to usage thresholds

facts.fact: According to the page's channel table, in-app win-back messages are shown upon app open after inactivity, with 1–2 messages.
facts.quote: In-App Messages Upon app open after inactivity 1–2 messages Context-driven

facts.fact: The page recommends a win-back subject line of roughly 30 to 50 characters.
facts.quote: Aim for roughly 30 to 50 characters.

facts.fact: The page states that phones cut subject lines off around 30 characters.
facts.quote: Phones cut subject lines off around 30 characters

facts.fact: The page states that the email guidance of 3 to 5 win-back emails and a send every 3–5 days are industry averages rather than laws.
facts.quote: loyalty and marketing experts suggest sending 3 to 5 emails. You’ll also know to send a win-back email every 3-5 days. Treat those as starting lines, not laws.

facts.fact: The page says JD Gyms offered members on frozen payments partner discounts and platform perks, but gives no monetary figure beyond 'worth hundreds of pounds a year' for the perks network.
facts.quote: a network of partner discounts and perks worth hundreds of pounds a year

facts.fact: The page states that Apple's Mail Privacy Protection inflates open rates by pre-loading images.
facts.quote: Apple’s Mail Privacy Protection now inflates opens by pre-loading images

facts.fact: JD Gyms' Plus membership programme drove a 5,700% rise in premium subscriptions, according to the page.
facts.quote: Their Plus membership programme, built on the same engagement thinking, drove a 5,700% rise in premium subscriptions

facts.fact: Marketing Metrics puts the probability of re-selling to a lapsed customer at 20-40%, versus 5-20% for a cold prospect.
facts.quote: Marketing Metrics puts the probability of re-selling to a lapsed customer at 20-40%, well above the 5-20% you would expect from a cold prospect.

facts.fact: The page advises starting win back campaigns 30-90 days after last customer activity, typically around day 45 for email.
facts.quote: Start win back campaigns 30-90 days after last customer activity, typically around day 45 for email.

facts.fact: The page advises SMS win back messages work best at 60-75 days of inactivity.
facts.quote: SMS works best at 60-75 days, while push notifications should trigger at 7, 14, and 30 days of inactivity based on usage thresholds.

facts.fact: The page advises push notifications should trigger at 7, 14, and 30 days of inactivity.
facts.quote: push notifications should trigger at 7, 14, and 30 days of inactivity based on usage thresholds.

facts.fact: The page recommends sending 3-5 win back emails spaced every 3-5 days.
facts.quote: Send 3-5 win back emails spaced every 3-5 days.

facts.fact: The page states successful win back campaigns should achieve 20-40% reactivation rates.
facts.quote: Successful campaigns should achieve 20-40% reactivation rates.

facts.fact: The page says a high-value customer earns a response in weeks, while a low-engagement customer can wait months before a win-back message.
facts.quote: A high-value customer earns a response in weeks. A low-engagement one can wait months.
